Skills("Main Weapon: Naginata pole-arm

Ninja Art: "Water Art": Allows her to create water around herself and use it as a weapon or for illusions. Useful in both offense and defense.

Geneijin: Allows her to mold water skillfully into illusions, in the form of decoys, clones or use it to create weapons directly. Rare ability use, even for skilled water users.

Area Illusion: She also can cast large scale illusion, within fog or rain. These large scale illusions can even take the form of large castles.

Bedroom Art: Inki Stream or Climax Diversion, secret Ninja Techniques, allows her to withstand stimulation.

Naginata master: She is a master with the spear and can beat Rinko with no big troubles in a fight with it.

Bedroom Art

Poison Claws: she has poison claws which inflict an aphrodisiac effect which can lead to death unless the pleasure isn't satisfied. The poison was only a cover for it to deliver an EVE chip.

Rubber Suit: She has a rubber suit to conceal herself in. Which makes her immune to Yukikaze's attacks. The suit also comes with a ball gag.

Succubus Abilities
Dream Manipulation: Able to enter and manipulate dreams, might be connected to her illusion art or just be a new Succubus ability. 

Life Force Drain: Like other Succubus, able to drain life force with intercourse.

Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.

Succubus Transformation: Like an Inner Demon increases her strength overall and puts her on the same level of King or Queen ranked demon noble. 

Backstory("Shiranui was one of the most powerful Taimanin in Gosha Village. Her strength, even now, is rivaled by the one-year younger Igawa Asagi, that Shiranui mentored multiple times and went on missions with.

As an elite exemplary Taimanin, she was the ideal many tried to become one day and well known for her illusions cast with her Water Art. It is mentioned that Shiranui married exceptionally young, around 14-18, either into or within the Mizuki clan. She loved her husband an expert in Lighting arts, and quickly gave birth in her teens, to her daughter Yukikaze.

While on that mission in Yomihara, Shiranui vanished. The disappearance of Shiranui was a shock and great loss to Gosha, which was unable to find any lead for the next few years. How, she was captured can be seen in the OVA as she was attacked by an Unidentified Female Slaver but if this is also true for normal canon is not fully clear. Shiranui was, at that point, given to Yazaki Toshiji (Real) of Under Eden and his brother Yazaki Muneichi a corrupt politician. 

Shiranui was moved out of Under Eden. As Yazaki Toshiji's constant failure in training for several years and letting Yukikaze escape, was considered too large. Shiranui was transported to Seishu Academy and the Washizu Material research facility, she was trained at this point for one year, under the influence of constant aphrodisiac. Her body had been modified but even with the training of Inui Hideo and Washizu Shigeru. Additional information is given in TABA, which does not contradict the main canon. Though she remained sane, after that year had passed, the Incubus King himself, Kuroi Ryuuji, saw her true value as a weapon. Taking her off the aphrodisiac, allowing her to bathe and have normal non drug filled meals. Shiranui though thankful was even more on edge. Though the Incubus King knew that such things were not even required in his case. Having sex with her, he used his supernatural abilities to copy, her old husband's skills and even genital, to break her mind in pleasure just to increase her beyond human levels, to a point Shiranui was fully losing herself in pleasure. Only in a few days of nonstop, intercourse, did she lose her connection to her human side, it is somewhat hinted that at this point, slight demonization took place as she does now give off a demonic aura or is called Succubus-like.")
